title: Comment “Work” And I’ll send you the link 👇 ChatGPT just launched a new agent built for real work
description: Comment “Work” And I’ll send you the link 👇 ChatGPT just launched a new agent built for real work projects. It’s called ChatGPT Work, powered by GPT-5.6. Now when you open the desktop app you’ll see three options: Chat → asking questions Codex → developers Work → turning your goals into finished work Here’s what makes Work different: It gathers context from the apps and files you approve, builds a plan, and carries it through multiple steps to a polished output you can actually use. Documents, spreadsheets, presentations, even working web experiences. And it checks in with you on the big decisions along the way. For example, it can organize job listings, compare them to your experience, and build out your application materials and a tracker ready to review. This is a solid step forward for anyone using ChatGPT for bigger projects. ChatGPT Work is available today in ChatGPT on web and mobile for Pro, Enterprise, and Edu, with Plus and Business rolling out over the next few days. In the ChatGPT desktop app, Chat, Work, and Codex are available on every plan, including Free, and is available globally to download on Windows and Mac. Download or update the ChatGPT desktop app to try it. #ChatGPT #AI #OpenAI #ChatGPTWork #ChatGPT_Partner ChatGPT
